latestReportSince(uint256).details: Reports are appended in non-decreasing block.timestamp order, so      the single latest report is always the one with the greatest      reportedAt. That means "the most recent report with      reportedAt >= notBefore" is simply the latest report, if its      timestamp clears the bar — no search needed.

latestReport().notice: The single most recent report, regardless of age. Reverts if         no report has ever been posted.

latestReportSince(uint256).notice: The most recent report with `reportedAt >= notBefore`.         Reverts if none exists — a missing report must block a         caller like CatBond.checkTrigger(), never silently default         to "not triggered."

maxReportAge().notice: Age, in seconds, past which a report can no longer be used         to settle a bond. Snapshotted from the product definition at         trigger deploy time.

postReport(uint256,bytes32).notice: Append a confirmed value from the off-chain monitor.         `monitorRef` is the hash of the specific monitor-buffer entry         this report was derived from — never posted from a live API         call made at report time. Reporter-only.

reportCount().notice: Number of reports ever posted. Used to check for an empty         report log before calling latestReport(), which reverts.

setReporter(address).notice: Change who may post reports. Owner-only. This is what lets an         oracle network be swapped in later with one call, per §2.4 —         not built for in this sprint (§0.5), but the door stays open.
